tour.welcomeBody: A 30-second tour of the essentials. You can skip it anytime.
tour.homeBody: Your day in one chronological list — overdue, dateless work, today, and the next 30 days. Quick-add at the top; the + button opens the full form.
tour.inboxBody: Capture a thought fast. It stays here — out of Home — until you plan it, so nothing gets lost and nothing clutters your day.
tour.projectsBody: Group work with a color and a README overview, with its own tasks and notes. Archive a project when it is done.
tour.notesBody: Rich notes you can pin, archive, and link to tasks and projects.
tour.doneBody: Reopen this tour anytime from Settings → App tour.
tour.filesBody: Your whole space’s files: personal folders plus everything attached to projects, tasks and notes.

problem.notificationsOff: Notifications are off — nothing can reach you. Tap to fix.
problem.provisional: Notifications arrive silently — no banner, no sound. Tap to fix.
problem.soundOff: Sound is off for AllisWell — alarms arrive without a sound. Tap to fix.
problem.alertOff: Banners are off — alarms only appear in Notification Centre. Tap to fix.
problem.exactAlarmsOff: Alarms may arrive late — allow “Alarms & reminders”. Tap to fix.
problem.timeSensitiveOff: Time Sensitive is off — Focus and Sleep will bury your alarms. Tap to fix.
problem.alarmKitOff: Alarm permission is off — urgent alarms can be silenced by the mute switch. Tap to fix.

fix.notificationsOff: Open Settings ▸ Notifications ▸ AllisWell and turn on “Allow Notifications”.
fix.provisional: Open Settings ▸ Notifications ▸ AllisWell and choose “Deliver Prominently”, then turn on Sounds.
fix.soundOff: Open Settings ▸ Notifications ▸ AllisWell and turn on “Sounds”. Without it an alarm still arrives — in silence.
fix.alertOff: Open Settings ▸ Notifications ▸ AllisWell and turn on “Lock Screen” and “Banners”.
fix.exactAlarmsOff: Grant “Alarms & reminders” so an alarm can ring at the exact minute instead of whenever the system next wakes up.
fix.timeSensitiveOff: Open Settings ▸ Notifications ▸ AllisWell and turn on “Time Sensitive Notifications”. Without it every Focus mode — including Sleep — hides your alarms.
fix.alarmKitOff: Open Settings ▸ AllisWell and allow Alarms. This is what lets an urgent alarm ring through silent mode and Focus.

alarmLog.title: Alarm log
alarmLog.sub: What this device did about alarms
alarmLog.scope: This is what the app DID: alarms it scheduled, ones it took back, the ones you touched, and the times the in-app alarm screen rang. iOS reports nothing about a notification you never touch, so the log never claims one was delivered.
alarmLog.emptyBody: Arm an alarm and it will show up here.

shareLog.title: Share log
shareLog.sub: What actually reached the app when you shared something
shareLog.scope: Every share that reaches AllisWell leaves a line here — the kind of payload and its size, never its content. If you shared something and this list stayed EMPTY, that is the answer: the payload never reached the app, so the problem is in the hand-off from the other app, not in what AllisWell did with it.
shareLog.emptyBody: Share some text or a file to AllisWell from another app and it will show up here.

reminderSettings.title: Reminder system
reminderSettings.sub: How many alerts, how far apart, and their order
reminderSettings.capacity: This chain fully covers about {count} alarms at once.
reminderSettings.capacityWarning: Long chains spend the system’s notification budget: beyond ~10 alerts, distant ones may be dropped until earlier ones pass.
reminderSettings.minGap: Alerts stay at least {minutes} minute apart, so two never collide.
reminderSettings.repeatAfterSnooze: Repeat the whole chain after a snooze
reminderSettings.repeatAfterSnoozeSub: Off: a snoozed alarm rings once when it comes back
reminderSettings.snoozeOrderSub: Drag to reorder — this is the order the ringing alarm shows
reminderSettings.snoozeOrderFirst: The alarm on your iPhone's Lock Screen has room for one snooze button: "{preset}".
reminderSettings.watchSub: While your phone is locked, alerts mirror to a paired watch — no separate app needed. Its sound and haptics are a watch setting: Watch → Sounds & Haptics.

sound.installFailed: Could not install that sound — the system sound stays.

sound.inAppOnlyUpload: This format can’t be an iOS notification sound; it will play in the in-app alarm.
sound.rules: A notification sound must be under 30 seconds and a .caf, .wav or .aiff file — mp3 and m4a can only play in the in-app alarm. On Android, an uploaded sound plays in the in-app alarm; notifications keep a built-in one.

apiKeys.title: API access

apiKeys.revokeConfirmBody: Anything using this key stops working immediately. This cannot be undone — you can always create a new key.
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create one when you want a script, a cron job or a home-automation box to reach your tasks and notes.
